other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months NoteNote
In relation to an offence committed before the time when section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the 'maximum term' is 6 months and in relation to an offence committed after that time, is 51 weeks.
